findings.title: Optional.of on a nullable email column throws NPE for rows with NULL email
findings.evidence: Inside the ResultSet try-with-resources, the single added return statement (line 17) maps the row with 'return rs.next() ? Optional.of(rs.getString("email")) : Optional.empty();'. When a user row exists but the email column is NULL, getString returns null and Optional.of(null) throws NullPointerException; the caller gets an uncaught NPE (not even SQLException) instead of the documented empty result. Reachable path: any existing id whose email column has no value.
findings.recommendation: Use Optional.ofNullable(rs.getString("email")) so a NULL email yields Optional.empty(); alternatively document and enforce a NOT NULL email constraint, but the code must not assume nullability of a column it does not control.
